entities.summary: Aaju Peter is an Inuk lawyer, activist and sealskin clothes designer. In 2012, she received the Order of Canada. She has appeared in the documentary films Arctic Defenders (2013) and Angry Inuk (2016). She was also profiled in the 2023 documentary film Twice Colonized.
